script: gw1-manual-run.ps1 (kept outside the repository, as for KS1)
defect: The SkillFlow checkpoint pre-check compared Get-FileHash of gamewatch/skillbook/book.json (raw bytes) with the book_sha256 that SkillFlow records, which SkillFlow computes after normalising CRLF to LF (runner.py sha256()). On a Windows checkout with CRLF line endings the two differ, so the script stopped at that pre-check (before any approval record, gate change or Kane process).

correction: Hash book.json after replacing CRLF with LF, as SkillFlow does. Applied by the operator (Eric) to the executed copy on 2026-11-24; reported in the project thread with the accepted GW1 result.
effectOnEvidence: None. The defect could only stop the script before any paid step; the Kane call, its gate, approval, ledger and findings are unaffected. The repair script (gw1-repair-run.ps1) uses the LF-normalised hash from the start.
